messages:
taylor (docs): Heads-up: I opened a small PR to update the model catalog compatibility table and add a migration example for quantized checkpoints. Would love quick reviews for accuracy + a link sanity check: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412

jin (eng-ml): Thanks — will take a look. Which edge cases do you want covered for quantized models? 8-bit->4-bit fallback behavior?

taylor (docs): Yes — 8->4 fallback and the sequence-length limit interactions with KV cache. Also there's a customer report about mismatched embed dims when using older tokenizer versions, so I added a short note.

alex (runtime): Re: KV cache and seq len — we should call out that models compiled with cross-attention opt sometimes have a lower max_cached_seq. I'll paste the command to repro the compile flags.

alex (runtime): ```bash
# reproduce kernel selection that caused lower cache size
python -m runtime.compile --model aether7b --optimize cross_attention --dry-run
```

sara (devex): I skimmed the PR. The SDK snippet needs to be updated to match the new client call shape. Current docs show `client.generate(prompt=...)` but we now recommend `client.text.generate(input=...)`. I can add a patch.

taylor (docs): Good catch. I added a TODO comment in the PR. If you can update the snippet, I'll update the surrounding prose.

jin (eng-ml): Quick note on benchmarks section: we should not publish the internal cluster numbers — instead publish per-token p50/p95 for a single dedicated instance and hyperlink to the internal report for teams with access. I updated the metric names in the PR.

taylor (docs): Updated. Also fixed one of the links that pointed to the old onboarding guide (404) — replaced with the new landing page. Can someone sanity-check the cross-ref to the rollout docs?

alex (runtime): Link looks good. I ran the example locally and noticed a missing `await` in the JS snippet for streaming. I'll push a tiny fix on the same branch.

sara (devex): Pushed SDK snippet fix. Also added a short migration checklist: pin model version, test prompt set, enable prefix cache.

deploy-bot: deploy queued for branch docs/model-catalog-compat at 2025-11-15T14:34:07Z :rocket:

taylor (docs): Awesome — thanks everyone. After the snippet + runtime patch I think it's ready to merge. I'll squash and request final approve. :thumbsup:

jin (eng-ml): Approved from my side. Ran the quick regression prompts and matches prior outputs (small diffs in whitespace only).

alex (runtime): Approved — verified compile flags note and added inline comment about follow-up telemetry to validate max_cached_seq behavior in production.

sara (devex): Approved. I added a short example showing how to migrate from `client.generate` to `client.text.generate` with both sync and async snippets.

taylor (docs): Merged. Thanks y'all. I'll open a follow-up issue for the telemetry verification and link it from the card.
